description:
Implement a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI agents like Claude Code
to run benchmarks, analyze results, and interact with BenchBox programmatically.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is Anthropic's open standard for connecting AI systems to
external tools and data sources. By implementing an MCP server, BenchBox becomes
accessible to any MCP-compatible AI agent, enabling natural language benchmark
orchestration.

The MCP server will expose BenchBox functionality through three primitives:
- **Tools**: Executable actions (run benchmarks, export results)
- **Resources**: Read-only data (benchmark metadata, historical results, system info)
- **Prompts**: Reusable templates (analysis patterns, comparison queries)

This enables use cases like:
- "Run TPC-H at scale factor 1 on DuckDB and show me the results"
- "Compare my last 3 benchmark runs and identify regressions"
- "Which platforms support the TPC-DS benchmark?"
- "Analyze query 5 performance across all my runs"
